study_design: Prospective cohort analysis within the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We prospectively examined serum retinol and risk of overall and site-specific cancer in the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study (n = 29,104 men), conducted in 1985-1993, with follow-up through 2012.
